title: Hearing Benefit Allowances, Trial and Warranty Terms
content:
Hearing terms carried by the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders.

| Rider | Hearing examination copayment (USD) | Hearing aid allowance for one ear (USD) | Hearing aids in a benefit year | Months before a hearing aid for the same ear is paid for again | Trial period (calendar days) | Manufacturer warranty (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 0.00 | 1250.00 | 2 | 36 | 60 | 36 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 2 | 24 | 60 | 36 |

## The terms defined

**Hearing examination copayment.** What the member pays for a hearing examination, in USD. It is 0.00 USD on every rider in the schedule.

**Hearing aid allowance for one ear.** The most the rider pays toward a hearing aid for one ear, in USD.

**Hearing aids in a benefit year.** How many hearing aids the rider pays for in a benefit year.

**Months before a hearing aid for the same ear is paid for again.** The months that must pass before a hearing aid for the same ear is paid for again.

**Trial period.** The calendar days a member may try a hearing aid and return it for a full refund.

**Manufacturer warranty.** The months of manufacturer warranty included with a hearing aid bought through the rider.

## Reading the schedule

Two riders carry hearing terms: the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider. Each pays for 2 hearing aids in a benefit year, allows a trial period of 60 calendar days and includes 36 months of manufacturer warranty.

They differ on two terms. The allowance for one ear is 1500.00 USD on the bundle rider against 1250.00 USD on the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider, and the interval before a hearing aid for the same ear is paid for again is 24 months on the bundle rider against 36 months on the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider.

The four remaining riders carry 0.00 USD and a count of 0 on every hearing term.
